title: HC1 prefix
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 9. Step 8 — Prefix the context identifier; HCERT Specification, 4.2.2 QR 2D Barcode. QR Code Generation, 9. Step 8 — Prefix the context identifier: “A future backwards-incompatible revision will use a new identifier, incrementing through [1-9] and then [A-Z].”.

statements.label: HC1 prefix
statements.requirement: The issuer SHALL prefix the Base45 string with "HC1:". The verifier SHALL require a context identifier matching HC[1-9A-Z]: and strip it. It SHALL report any identifier other than HC1 as an unsupported version, distinct from malformed input.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-HC1-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-HC1-001 HC1 is the only context, version 1 the only version` (PrefixContextTest.kt)).
